description: Show how this works before the person shares anything: made-up people, each with their own documents and a school. Without `persona`, the list of examples to choose from; with one, that person's prepared run step by step (formal education, work and credentials, the Selfie, the drafted claims, will-my-credits-transfer and the suggested credit), each with a plain explanation line. Every answer is marked example: true; none of these people is real, and nothing here is the person's own data.

persona.description: Optional: an example's persona_id from the list, e.g. maria

name: show_me_an_example

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package, with this service's part filled

scenarios.description: Without a persona: each example's persona_id, display_name, label, description, aspiration and institution_name

steps.description: With a persona: each step's tool, its answer as the tool returned it, and its explanation line

title: Show Me An Example
